Luma Summer Kit – Your Summer Scent Ritual
Step into summer with Luma – a luxurious 3-piece set designed to make you glow, smell irresistible, and feel effortlessly fresh all day.
Inside the kit:

Hair & Body Perfume (50ml) – A captivating summer scent that lingers beautifully, perfect for layering or wearing on its own.
Scented Shimmer Gel (50ml) – A lightweight gel base infused with a shimmering mix of gold, pearly white, and pink pigments. Glides onto the skin with a cooling feel, and once dry, the shimmer stays, leaving a luminous glow and a long-lasting fragrance.
Body Lotion (50ml) – Lightweight yet nourishing, it locks in moisture and enhances your scent for hours.

 Notes : Pear , citrus , coconut powder , woody base.
From sun-kissed mornings to vibrant summer nights, Luma is your ultimate warm-weather essential – a fragrance and beauty ritual in one.
